mapper.insert: insert into club_edition_compensation_terms (topic_id, executing_club_id, fixed_compensation, extra_hour_rate, quality_dimension_amount, quality_dimensions, evidence_due_at, fulfillment_end_at, extra_approver_user_id, headcount_rate, headcount_cap, config_hash, frozen_at) values (#{topicId}, #{executingClubId}, #{fixedCompensation}, #{extraHourRate}, #{qualityDimensionAmount}, #{qualityDimensions}, #{evidenceDueAt}, #{fulfillmentEndAt}, #{extraApproverUserId}, #{headcountRate}, #{headcountCap}, #{configHash}, #{frozenAt})
mapper.select: select t.topic_id as topicId, t.executing_club_id as executingClubId, c.name as topicName, c.img_url as topicCover, c.start_date as startDate, t.evidence_due_at as evidenceDueAt, t.fulfillment_end_at as fulfillmentEndAt, t.frozen_at as frozenAt from club_edition_compensation_terms t left join cms_topic c on c.id = t.topic_id where t.executing_club_id = #{clubId} order by t.topic_id desc

select count(*) from coop_order co where co.to_type = 'club' and co.to_id = #{clubId} and co.role_snapshot = 'ORGANIZER' and co.status = 0 and co.del_flag = 0 and co.topic_id is not null and not exists ( select 1 from coop_invite legacy_invite where legacy_invite.id = co.invite_id and legacy_invite.invite_type = 2 )
select count(*) from club_edition_legacy_exemption where topic_id = #{topicId}
select fixed_compensation from topic_edition_cost where topic_id = #{topicId} and is_current = 1
select headcount_rate as headcountRate, headcount_cap as headcountCap from topic_edition_cost where topic_id = #{topicId} and is_current = 1
select extra_approver_user_id from topic_edition_cost where topic_id = #{topicId} and is_current = 1 and extra_approver_user_id > 0
select g_earned from topic_edition_funds where topic_id = #{topicId} and snapshot_kind = 'FINAL' and is_current = 1

select a.id, a.funds_snapshot_id as fundsSnapshotId, a.source_club_id as sourceClubId, a.ticket_count as ticketCount, a.net_ticket_count as netTicketCount, a.earned_amount as earnedAmount from topic_edition_funds f join topic_edition_funds_attribution a on a.funds_snapshot_id = f.id where f.topic_id = #{topicId} and f.snapshot_kind = 'FINAL' and f.is_current = 1 order by a.source_key
mapper.insert: insert into club_edition_hours (topic_id, club_id, hour_kind, planned_hours, confirm_status) select #{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{hourKind}, #{plannedHours}, 'UNREPORTED' from dual where not exists (select 1 from club_edition_compensation_terms where topic_id = #{topicId}) on duplicate key update planned_hours = #{plannedHours}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: update club_edition_hours set reported_actual_hours = #{reportedActualHours}, reported_by = #{reportedBy}, reported_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), confirm_status = 'REPORTED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} and hour_kind = #{hourKind} and confirm_status in ('UNREPORTED', 'REPORTED', 'REJECTED')

update club_edition_hours set confirmed_actual_hours = #{confirmedActualHours}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} and hour_kind = #{hourKind} and confirm_status = 'REPORTED'
mapper.select: select * from club_edition_hours where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} order by hour_kind
mapper.insert: insert into club_edition_hours_correction (topic_id, club_id, hour_kind, previous_confirmed_hours, previous_confirmed_by, previous_confirmed_at, reopened_by, reason, reopened_at) values (#{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{hourKind}, #{previousConfirmedHours}, #{previousConfirmedBy}, #{previousConfirmedAt}, #{reopenedBy}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

insert into club_extra_hours_approval (topic_id, club_id, category, approved_hours, approved_by, approved_at, work_started_at, idempotency_key, correction_of, note) select #{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{category}, #{approvedHours}, #{approvedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{workStartedAt}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{correctionOf}, #{note} from dual where #{correctionOf} is not null or #{workStartedAt} > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: select * from club_extra_hours_approval where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} order by id
select count(*) from club_extra_hours_approval where correction_of = #{correctionOf}
mapper.insert: insert into club_quality_decision (topic_id, club_id, dimension, decision_status, amount, evidence_hash, excluded_by_fault, fault_party, reason, due_at, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, decision_version, is_current, correction_of) values (#{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{dimension}, #{decisionStatus}, #{amount}, #{evidenceHash}, #{excludedByFault}, #{faultParty}, #{reason}, #{dueAt}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedAt}, #{version}, #{current}, #{correctionOf})
mapper.update: update club_quality_decision set is_current = 0 where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} and dimension = #{dimension} and is_current = 1
mapper.select: select * from club_quality_decision where topic_id = #{topicId} and club_id = #{clubId} and is_current = 1 order by dimension
